cl. 4. P. भृश्यति, to fall, fall down, Dhātup. xxvi, 115 (cf. √ भ्रंश्, भ्रश्, of which √ भृश् is only the weak form);
 cl. 6. P. भृशति, to be strong or vehement, Vop. (rather Nom. fr. next).

(perhaps the original meaning may be ‘falling heavily’, cf. √ भ्रश्) strong, vehement, mighty, powerful, frequent, abundant (often ibc. cf. below; rarely as an independent word; cf. सुभृत), Mn.; MBh. &c.
ibc. and (अम् ind.) strongly, violently, vehemently, excessively, greatly, very much, Mn.; MBh. &c.
harshly, severely, ChUp.
quickly, without hesitation, MBh.
often, frequently, R.
eminently, in a superior manner, L.
a partic. tutelary deity, VarBṛ.
ind.
भृश—कोपन mfn. extremely passionate, very wrathful, MBh.
भृश—ता f. violence, intensity, Ragh.
भृश—दण्ड mfn. inflicting severe punishment on (loc.), Mn. vii, 32.
भृश—दारुण mfn. very terrible or cruel, Nal.
भृश—दुःखित mfn. very much afflicted, very unfortunate or unhappy, Nal.
भृश—नास्तिक mfn. very sceptical or impious, MBh.
भृश—पत्त्रिका f. ‘strong-leaved’, a species of plant, L.
भृश—पीडित mfn. very much afflicted, MW.
भृश—विस्मित mfn. excessively astonished or perplexed, R.
भृश—वेदना f. violent pain, MW.
भृश—शोक-वर्धन mf(ई)n. greatly increasing grief or sorrow, MBh.
भृश—संयुत mfn. very much engaged in (instr.), ib.
भृश—संहृष्ट mfn. very delighted or glad, ib.
भृश—स्विद् mfn. perspiring violently, Śiś.
Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to become powerful or strong or vehement, Bhaṭṭ.
भृशी-√ भू P. -भवति id., Vop.
1. भृष्ट mfn. fallen &c., L.
&c. See under √ भ्रज्ज्.
2. भृष्ट mfn. (for 1. See p. 766, col. 1) fried, broiled, grilled, roasted, baked, GṛŚrS.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
roasted meat (see next).
1. भृष्टि॑ f. (cf. √ हृष्; for 2. भृष्टि See under √ भ्रज्ज्) a spike, point, top, corner, edge, RV.; AV.; GṛS. (cf. सह॑स्र-, क्षुर-भृ˚ &c.)
a deserted cottage or garden, L.
2. भृष्टि f. (for 1. See p. 766, col. 1) the act of frying or boiling or roasting, L.
raised ground near a tank, for planting Piper Betel upon, Inscr.
भृष्टि—म॑त् mfn. pronged, toothed, RV.
भृष्टि—म॑त् m. N. of a Ṛṣi.
भृष्ट—कार m. a preparer of roasted or fried meat, R.
भृष्ट—तण्डुल m. roasted grain, Suśr.
भृष्ट—पिष्ट n. roasted meal, Kauś.
भृष्ट—यव m. fried barley or rice, L.
rice boiled and then fried, W.
